segments.en: He led five people from among the worldly ones, and he said to them, ‘May there be no anger (among you).’ To the Hearers he said, ‘May no one dishearten you that you remain in the world. For you are friends of the friends (the Elect), you are Hearers (who) by fasting [...] and who by another [...] {Lines missing} …
leader of the brothers and sisters who obey the command (i.e. virgins?). {one line blank}

segments.en: when among […] the circuit of the wheel […] (10) they will be, and great profit and betterment […] and with all conduct of wisdom […] together they will be made ready. {Final benediction?} Then after [… the adornment again of propriety and […] on you propriety and perfection and [..] I hear [… (15) …] you remain (or Mani or amen). And amen. {Scribal note} And they ask, [… the] bishops and the presbyters of peace- fulness [together] with the hymn-singers, likewise the brethren […] the congregations. And they sent [a letter to the …] holy dwelling (?). [S2?] {The start of a second epistle} [Mani, the apostle of Jesus Aryaman, and […] with me; to the most beloved …] letters / by letter to you […] loved and most dear ones whom I, together with my own soul […] having the same body, – [you are] a visible store of light! {Recapitulation of the theme of the previous letter} […] I [t]each […] children of the apostles (?) [… (5) …] and […] the command of God […] establish [the] commu- nity of the) virtuous (i.e. the hearers). […] he (or ‘you’ pl.) will establish [… (10) …] you also thereupon be a helper everywhere […] so strive that (the first) letter […] and also this second one which I now [send …] to read it and collect with it, and to every […] to establish, and all together [… (15) …] consider to make familiar witn [… shall be] recited; and your reward and recompense [… …] and with that we too [shall be] content and grateful. {Prayer formula} [..] and be preserved by the right-hand of well-being and that God of [truth (?). …] my dear brother, with all righteousness […] and [may you be protected from] (20) all misfortune, harm and doubt […] community in Georgia (?) + M9152 [S1?] […] that to the most beloved […] at ease and healthy you remain. [… …s]o(?) that with the aid of the angels you, the most beloved, [in spirit(?)] are well, and as for the body content and happy. segments.en: hostel of yours, the most beloved, there may be good well-being. And from all sides there may then be for you peace from thegods, and good luck may be allotted. [S2?] [ ] came to … ? … they gr]ant that we, when we from afar through a little [com- fort(?)]. which (is) from you, through your wisdom, piety, love and gentleness, honour and affection, have been bettered, thereupon we many [times(?)] (5) planned that I myself with corporeal eyes might see the most beloved brethren […]. But t[ill then] that we shall see each other, before (that), [we send you] a letter of love and affection, and an epistle of salutation and gratitude and charity.
